heading: **January 5 2026**
body:
1. *Hia5 test in SELEX & NCAP-SELEX buffer*

We have consistently been using 0.5 uL of *Hia5* for treating \~300 ng DNA. By this context, 0.05 uL of the enzyme to be used for 30 ng i.e. per well.

Approximately we want to use 8 uL of Hia5 distributed across 384 wells → this equates to about 0.021 uL per well.

For testing → Take 0.5 uL of enzyme and dilute to 10 uL in Hia5 buffer

SELEX Hia5 optimisation:

4.5 uL TF dilution buffer \+ 8.5 uL 1.55X SELEX Buffer \+ 30 ng DNA (1 uL) \+ 1 uL dHia5 \+ 0.5 uL SAM \+ 4.5 uL Hia5 buffer

NCAP-SELEX Buffer: 13.9 uL Biotin Buffer \+ 2.5 uL TF dilution buffer \+ 30 ng DNA (1 uL) \+ 1 uL dHia5 \+ 0.5 uL SAM \+ 1.1 uL Hia5 buffer

Control:

30 ng DNA (1 uL) \+ 1 uL dHia5 \+ 0.5 uL SAM \+ 17.5 uL Hia5 buffer

| 37 C | 1 hour |
| :---- | :---- |
| 80 C | 10 mins |

*Dpn*I digestion:

Add 2.3 uL Cutsmart buffer \+ 1 uL DpnI to each sample and incubate:

| 37 C | 1 hour |
| :---- | :---- |
| 80 C | 20 mins |
title: 1. Hia5 test in SELEX & NCAP-SELEX buffer
